scope: UCI Taiwan default dataset; compared six data-mining methods.
main_finding: Probability quality matters more than only hard classification.
SMOTE-XGBoost can improve recall/AUC in imbalanced default prediction.
relevance_to_project: Motivates testing resampling, though our SMOTENC did not win.

scope: Compared statistical and machine-learning models on the UCI dataset.
main_finding: Modern ML models achieved about 0.77 AUC and around 81.8% top accuracy.
relevance_to_project: Our XGBoost AUC 0.780 is in the expected literature band.

scope: SHAP stability case study using 100 XGBoost models.
main_finding: Top SHAP drivers tend to be more stable than middle-ranked features.
relevance_to_project: Directly motivates our 10-seed SHAP stability analysis.
